title: Vocabulary and Word Meaning — Level 8 — Arrange and transform

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: waste / reduces / in landfills / recycling / the amount of

visual.text: Recycling reduces the amount of waste in landfills.

choices.say: Recycling reduces the amount of waste in landfills.

visual.text: Recycling the amount of waste reduces in landfills.

choices.say: Recycling the amount of waste reduces in landfills.

visual.text: The amount of recycling reduces waste in landfills.

choices.say: The amount of recycling reduces waste in landfills.

visual.text: Waste reduces recycling the amount of in landfills.

choices.say: Waste reduces recycling the amount of in landfills.

items.reteach: Pola: subject (Recycling) + verb (reduces) + object (the amount of waste) + keterangan.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: to save / were / the students / encouraged / water at school

visual.text: The students were encouraged to save water at school.

choices.say: The students were encouraged to save water at school.

visual.text: The students were to save encouraged water at school.

choices.say: The students were to save encouraged water at school.

visual.text: The students encouraged were to save water at school.

choices.say: The students encouraged were to save water at school.

visual.text: Were the students to save encouraged water at school.

choices.say: Were the students to save encouraged water at school.

items.reteach: Passive: subject + were + encouraged + to + verb.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: the way / smartphones / people communicate / have changed

visual.text: Smartphones have changed the way people communicate.

choices.say: Smartphones have changed the way people communicate.

visual.text: Smartphones the way have changed people communicate.

choices.say: Smartphones the way have changed people communicate.

visual.text: The way smartphones people communicate have changed.

choices.say: The way smartphones people communicate have changed.

visual.text: People communicate smartphones have changed the way.

choices.say: People communicate smartphones have changed the way.

items.reteach: "The way people communicate" = cara orang berkomunikasi, menjadi objek dari "have changed".

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: every year / attracts / thousands of tourists / the volcano

visual.text: The volcano attracts thousands of tourists every year.

choices.say: The volcano attracts thousands of tourists every year.

visual.text: The volcano every year thousands of tourists attracts.

choices.say: The volcano every year thousands of tourists attracts.

visual.text: Thousands of tourists the volcano attracts every year.

choices.say: Thousands of tourists the volcano attracts every year.

visual.text: Attracts the volcano thousands of tourists every year.

choices.say: Attracts the volcano thousands of tourists every year.

items.reteach: Pola SVO + keterangan waktu di akhir.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: clearly / explained / our teacher / of the word / the meaning

visual.text: Our teacher explained the meaning of the word clearly.

choices.say: Our teacher explained the meaning of the word clearly.

visual.text: Our teacher the meaning explained of the word clearly.

choices.say: Our teacher the meaning explained of the word clearly.

visual.text: Our teacher explained clearly of the word the meaning.

choices.say: Our teacher explained clearly of the word the meaning.

visual.text: The meaning of our teacher explained the word clearly.

choices.say: The meaning of our teacher explained the word clearly.

items.reteach: Subject + explained + object (the meaning of the word) + adverb (clearly).

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: depend on / to grow apples / farmers in Batu / fertile soil

visual.text: Farmers in Batu depend on fertile soil to grow apples.

choices.say: Farmers in Batu depend on fertile soil to grow apples.

visual.text: Farmers in Batu fertile soil depend on to grow apples.

choices.say: Farmers in Batu fertile soil depend on to grow apples.

visual.text: Fertile soil depend on farmers in Batu to grow apples.

choices.say: Fertile soil depend on farmers in Batu to grow apples.

visual.text: Farmers in Batu depend on to grow apples fertile soil.

choices.say: Farmers in Batu depend on to grow apples fertile soil.

items.reteach: "Depend on" + objek (fertile soil), lalu tujuan (to grow apples).

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct sentence: back up / you / your important files / should / regularly

visual.text: You should back up your important files regularly.

choices.say: You should back up your important files regularly.

visual.text: You should your important files back up regularly.

choices.say: You should your important files back up regularly.

visual.text: You back up should your important files regularly.

choices.say: You back up should your important files regularly.

visual.text: Should you back up regularly your important files.

choices.say: Should you back up regularly your important files.

items.reteach: Modal should + verb dasar (back up) + objek + adverb.
